messages.subject_clean: geom_range not correctly displaying 95% HPDs for height from BEAST tree
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
Thank you for an incredible book and great resource. I've been using your book to plot MCC trees inferred with BEAST. I'm hoping to plot 95% CIs for node time in years. I'm a bit confused about the correct range to use for the node uncertainty. Would you be able to point me towards information about the height vs. length parameters?

Currently, I plot with:
```
ggtree(b, mrsd = mrsd)  +
  geom_range(range='height_0.95_HPD', color='grey', alpha=.6, size=2,  branch.length="height") +
  theme_tree2()
```
Thank you in advance!

> Dear Guangchuang Yu,
>
> I am plotting a calibrated tree several hundred million years old, and using geom_range to plot the height intervals. I had not realized until now, but the bars are actually not in the right place! >
> Do you have any idea of how to solve that? It is hard for me to send the tree as an example because it is a huge script to get to where it is now, but the case is exactly the same as in the GitHub.
>
> Please let me know what you think.
> Thank you in advance,
> Tauana

messages.body_plain:
I didn't reproduce problems1.
As for problems2, I'd suggest dealing with the label first.

library("ggplot2")
library("ggtree")
library("treeio")
library("tidytree")
#tree
nwk <- "test.treefile"
tree <- read.tree(nwk)
#Extract node label
bootsv <-data.frame(tree[["node.label"]])
ntip <- length(tree[["tip.label"]])
nnode <- tree[["Nnode"]]
SHaLRT <- data.frame(lapply(bootsv, function(x) as.numeric(sub("/.*", "",x))))
UFBoot <-data.frame(lapply(bootsv, function(x) as.numeric(sub(".*/", "",x))))
support <- cbind(SHaLRT, UFBoot)
colnames(support) <- c("SHaLRT", "UFBoot")
row.names(support) <- c((ntip + 1) : (ntip + nnode))
#Remove values below 50
support <- support[which(support$SHaLRT >=50 & support$UFBoot >=50),]
#cut data
support$UFBoot <- cut(as.numeric(support$UFBoot), breaks = c(50,60,70,80,90,100),right = F,include.lowest = TRUE)
#Put the results back into the tree.
tree[["node.label"]] <- support$UFBoot
#make a color list
col = c("cyan1", "green1", "yellow1", "palevioletred1", "blueviolet")
names(col) = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
#plot
tree <- ggtree(tree) +
  geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip,colour = label), size=2.2)+
  geom_tiplab(size = 2.6, align=TRUE, linesize=0.25)+
  geom_text(aes(label=node)) +
  geom_hilight(node=26, fill="red", alpha=.5) +
  geom_hilight(node=35, fill="blue", alpha=.5, extend=0.19) +
  scale_colour_manual("UFBoot(SHaLRT>=50)", #legend name

                    labels = c("50<=UFBoot<60", "60<=UFBoot<70", "70<=UFBoot<80",  "80<=UFBoot<90", "90<=UFBoot<100"))  #rename key label of legend
